protocol: Frozen binary and queries; per-agent evidence; root verifies Luna assessments.
Offline L1-L4; L5-L7 run14predefinedepisodes serialized by a shared lock; allowed Serp Seznam only unless available ledger says otherwise.
One durable shared refusal ledger; no retry after challenge/403/429; stop LLM calls after model refusal.
Reference primary pages read separately before freeze; no referenceURL injection into product.
Cache warm repetition is explicitly S01W; not an independent new query.
News fulfillment, source relevance, exact witness provenance, semantic support and budgets graded separately. No pooled corpus-recall claim.
